title: Boil water / do not drink notice
description: Tier 1 drinking-water public notice in the EPA template format: 'DRINKING WATER WARNING' header, the required Spanish-language line, the action headline (variant 'boil_water': BOIL YOUR WATER BEFORE USING; variant 'do_not_drink': DO NOT DRINK YOUR WATER), What should I do?, What happened? What is being done?, the 'please share this information' paragraph and the PWS ID footer. The utility and places are simulated. One Letter page.

utility.description: Public water system name (the exercising utility)

noticeType.description: Kind of advisory; boil_water goes with the boil_water variant, do_not_drink and do_not_use with the do_not_drink variant

contaminant.description: What the water is (or may be) contaminated with, completes '<utility> water is contaminated with …'
examples: a chemical from a treatment plant overfeed

affectedArea.description: Who is affected (area, pressure zone, streets)
examples: All customers in the Eastside pressure zone, east of the Mill River

whatHappened.description: What happened (cause, sample results, loss of pressure)
examples: Samples collected on October 20 tested positive for E. coli.
DO NOT DRINK THE WATER WITHOUT BOILING IT FIRST. Bring all water to a boil, let it boil for one minute, and let it cool before using.
We are flushing mains, increasing chlorine and collecting more samples.

expectedResolution.description: When the advisory is expected to be lifted
examples: We expect to resolve the problem within 3 days.

languageNote.description: Required non-English line (defaults to the EPA Spanish sentence)
examples: Este informe contiene información muy importante sobre su agua de beber. Tradúzcalo o hable con alguien que lo entienda bien.
